fileDrop.instructions: Drag and drop files here, or
fileDrop.emptyFolder: No file found in the folder.

excluded.one: {count} system file was left out (such as .DS_Store or Thumbs.db).
excluded.other: {count} system files were left out (such as .DS_Store or Thumbs.db).

rejected.one: {count} file was not added because its name or folder is not accepted.
rejected.other: {count} files were not added because their name or folder is not accepted.

reason.bidi-control: text direction character in the name
reason.leading-or-trailing-space-or-dot: name starting with a space or ending with a space or a dot
reason.empty-segment: empty folder name in the path
reason.too-deep: folders nested too deeply (16 levels at most)
reason.too-many: too many files in the transfer

fileList.label: Selected files
fileList.hidden: Hidden file (name starting with a dot)

copy.label: Copy
copy.failed: Copy failed: select the text and copy it manually
